As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment. This Position Reports To Head of Cash Management Reporting to the Head of Trade & Structured Finance, you will join ABB Robotics’ newly established global Trade Finance function and play a key role in building a modern, scalable capability for the standalone organization. You will manage a broad portfolio of trade finance activities, with a strong focus on bank guarantees, while partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Treasury and banking partners across the world. Beyond day-to-day execution, you will help shape global processes, ensure efficient and compliant trade finance operations and contribute to automation and digitalization. This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to take ownership and help build something new in a fast-moving international environment. The work model for the role is: hybrid ; The location can be within Europe. Your Responsibilities Global guarantee management: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of bank guarantees, parent company guarantees, bonds and other trade finance instruments across ABB Robotics’ global entities. Business partnering: Work closely with Sales, Key Account Management, Finance, Legal and business teams to understand requirements and provide practical trade finance guidance. Bank coordination: Coordinate with banks and financial institutions on guarantee issuance, wording, documentation, limits and day-to-day transactions across multiple countries. Portfolio & reporting: Monitor the guarantee portfolio, facilities, expiries, utilization and fees, maintaining accurate records and providing relevant reporting and KPIs. Structured & working-capital finance: Support the Head of Trade & Structured Finance with solutions such as receivables factoring, supply-chain/payables finance and leasing-related structures. Process improvement & digitalization: Help develop standardized processes, controls and systems and drive automation and continuous improvement across global trade finance operations. Qualifications For The Role Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Treasury or a related field. 5+ years of relevant experience in Trade Finance, Treasury Operations, Banking or Corporate Finance, with proven experience working in a multinational environment and with global banking partners Strong knowledge of bank guarantees, bonds, letters of credit and international trade finance practices. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders in an international environment. Analytical, detail-oriented and process-driven, with an interest in automation, digitalization and continuous improvement. Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Prepare commercial proposals and negotiate pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines. Convert opportunities into signed customers and recurring coffee volume. Achieve agreed monthly and annual targets for: New B2B accounts Coffee volume in kilograms Revenue Gross margin Customer retention Account Development Maintain strong relationships with customers after acquisition. Regularly visit key accounts and identify opportunities to increase consumption and account value. Develop opportunities for additional SKUs, blends, origins, locations or related products. Communicate our product quality and value proposition confidently to café owners, F&B managers, purchasing teams and coffee professionals. Coordinate closely with the Head of Coffee / Coffee Specialist on: Coffee selection Blend development Tastings and cuppings Brewing calibration Barista training Product troubleshooting Translate technical coffee knowledge into clear commercial benefits for customers. Commercial & Market Intelligence Monitor competitor activities, product offerings, coffee prices and market trends. Maintain current knowledge of major coffee suppliers and roasters operating in Qatar. Provide regular feedback on competitor pricing, customer requirements and emerging opportunities. Identify market gaps that can be commercially leveraged. Support management in developing pricing, product and market-entry strategies. Pipeline Management & Reporting Maintain an accurate and updated sales pipeline in the CRM. Provide clear forecasts of potential new customers, expected volumes and closing timelines. Maintain proper records of customer visits, proposals, negotiations and follow-up actions. Provide regular sales and market-development reports to the Head of Sales. Follow up consistently on all open opportunities until a clear outcome is reached. Customer Onboarding Coordinate internally to ensure smooth onboarding of every new customer. Commercial understanding of pricing, margin and account profitability. Excellent spoken and written English. Valid Qatar driving licence and ability to travel extensively across the market. Strongly Preferred Existing relationships with café owners, specialty coffee operators, hotel F&B teams, procurement managers, restaurant groups or roasteries in Qatar. Barista experience or SCA-related training. Arabic language capability. Familiarity with espresso machines, grinders and café operations. We are looking for someone with a genuine hunter mentality . Strong in the field: enjoys visiting customers, meeting people and being physically present in the market. Persistent and resilient: comfortable with rejection and willing to follow up repeatedly until an opportunity is won or clearly closed. Commercially hungry: motivated by winning accounts, growing volume and exceeding targets. Entrepreneurial: comfortable joining a new business and helping build the customer base from the ground up. Relationship-driven: capable of building credibility with everyone from café owners and head baristas to hotel GMs, F&B Directors and purchasing managers. Credible and passionate about coffee: genuinely interested in specialty coffee and willing to continuously deepen technical knowledge. A strong communicator: confident presenting, negotiating and influencing customers. Disciplined: maintains an organized pipeline, customer records and follow-up process. Independent: able to plan daily market activity and work with limited supervision. Team-oriented: works closely with the Head of Sales, Head of Coffee and operational teams rather than operating in isolation. Result-oriented: understands that activity is important, but ultimately performance is measured by converted customers, profitable sales and kilograms of coffee sold.
